folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B225, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All twelve TF kinds, both carry matrices, control cases, proposed transition fields, E map and TX rows were read. Configuration change within one body, new body creation, change of operator and replacement of a person are separate operations. A returned body has its current retained damage, gear, location and commitments under its actual absence policy; the original preview is not authority to overwrite intervening state. History capped at32 cannot be the sole live return pointer. Title, physical custody, current executor, actual knower and affected observer are different references (AD32/AD36).

The proposed transaction explicitly distinguishes abort before commit from supported compensation/restoration after commit. A post-durable UI failure does not authorize replaying or undoing paid work; B170/B203 retain actual later transaction repairs and their proof limits. Preserve named unique item/pool references through carried, parked, consumed and repaired states, rather than giving both an old and new object the same title. A current body migration may remain smaller than the unselected full schema proposal in B220. Single-body and later registry shapes are alternatives with explicit version decisions, not two mutable truths at once.

Read no-XP/no-duplication wording by mechanism: previews, repeated import and duplicate settlement create no new real occurrence. Supported repeated transformations can genuinely train a method, repair tissue, regenerate material or grant multiple participants learning if the selected power actually does so. One shared pool is one balance, while independently real producers may contribute different output. There is no universal ban on profitable regrowth or strong/free faculties, and no mandatory tax or awkwardness grind for changing body (AD22/AD38). Local stored-form restoration and bodily injury carry rules remain dials supported by source.

Source comparisons retain edition/stage/context: book versus film presentation, normal dose expiry versus wrong-material care, separate awakening cases, page-level secondary fiend memory, and unresolved brain/body/chimera identity. A page-level chapter list does not settle sentence-specific law. The cited PDF locators were not opened or extracted in this review. Tern is a bounded inspected historical seam, detached traveler intents are not registered native commands, and neither establishes the full return/remote aging engine. B218–B224 qualify source/default body/clock/recognition claims without resolving unknown canon.

Current desktop/prose-first targets and AD42 qualify old1366-primary/human acceptance wording; AD51 qualifies generalized second-consumer thresholds. Timed return, partner revocation and support loss need actual executable policy, not universal teleport, complete refund or erasure of learned history. These are selected-consumer requirements, not a reason to gate unrelated current worlds on every transformation kind. No transformation, migration, command, native play or persistence check was implemented or run here.
